newsitem.title: POLAND: UNIVERSAL REFUSED CAR IMPORT LICENCE.
newsitem.headline: UNIVERSAL REFUSED CAR IMPORT LICENCE.

text.p: Polish trader Universal SA did not receive a licence for the duty-free import of parts for assembling Hyundai cars, the economy ministry said in a statement on Friday.
"The economy minister decided to maintain an (earlier) decision...(which) means Universal did not receive permission for the duty-free imports of car parts," the statement said.
Last August the government issued a regulation under which only already existing car assembly plants could import car parts duty-free.

Universal had applied for the permit saying it had a Hyundai assembly plant near Warsaw but the then Foreign Trade Ministry ruled that the facilities were not what it understood by a car assembly plant.

At the start of this year Universal re-applied to the new ministry for the permit after the reform of the Polish governent's administration scrapped the Foreign Trade Ministry and established the Economy Ministry.
